Class TorrentInfo

java.lang.Object
com.alexswd.top.torrent.parser.TorrentInfo
public class TorrentInfo extends Object
Data model representing the metadata of a torrent file.

This class encapsulates all parsed information from a torrent file, including:

  • Announce URLs and tracker information
  • Piece information (length, hashes)
  • File listing (single or multi-file torrents)
  • Metadata (name, creation date, encoding, comments)
  • The info hash (unique identifier)

TorrentInfo instances are typically created by TorrentParser after parsing a torrent file. The class provides getters and setters for all fields, as well as utility methods like getPieceCount(), getInfoHashBytes(), and a detailed toString() representation.

Thread safety: Instances are not thread-safe by default. Callers should synchronize access if shared across multiple threads.

Since:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • TorrentInfo

      public TorrentInfo(String filePath, String announce, List<String> announceList, String comment, String createdBy, long creationDate, String encoding, String name, long pieceLength, List<String> pieceHashes, boolean isPrivate, boolean isMultiFile, long totalLength, List<TorrentFile> files, String infoHash)
      Constructs a TorrentInfo with all metadata fields.

      Creates defensive copies of the input collections to prevent external modification.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the torrent file
      announce - the primary announce URL
      announceList - the list of announce URLs from announce-list
      comment - the torrent comment
      createdBy - the creator/application string
      creationDate - the creation date as Unix timestamp (seconds)
      encoding - the character encoding used
      name - the torrent name
      pieceLength - the length of each piece in bytes
      pieceHashes - the list of SHA-1 hashes (hexadecimal) for each piece
      isPrivate - whether this is a private torrent
      isMultiFile - whether this is a multi-file torrent
      totalLength - the total size of all files in bytes
      files - the list of TorrentFile objects
      infoHash - the hexadecimal representation of the SHA-1 info hash

    • TorrentInfo

      public TorrentInfo(TorrentInfo source)
      Constructs a TorrentInfo as a deep copy of another TorrentInfo instance.

      All fields are copied, including deep copies of mutable collections (announceList, pieceHashes, files). If the source is null, the constructor completes without initializing fields.

      Parameters:
      source - the TorrentInfo instance to copy, or null

    • getInfoHash

      public String getInfoHash()
      Gets the hexadecimal representation of the info hash.

      The info hash is the SHA-1 hash of the bencode-encoded info dictionary. It uniquely identifies the torrent.

      Returns:
      the info hash as a hexadecimal string

    • getPieceCount

      public int getPieceCount()
      Calculates the number of pieces in the torrent.

      Uses ceiling division to account for partial final pieces if the total length is not evenly divisible by the piece length.

      Returns:
      the number of pieces (rounds up if necessary)

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a formatted string representation of the torrent metadata.

      Includes a detailed summary of all torrent information including name, info hash, sizes, piece information, file listings, and tracker URLs. The output is formatted with box-drawing characters for visual clarity.

      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
